provenance.measurement: Fresh runtime/RSS; changed candidate application sources, unchanged compiler, inputs and foreign reference bytes. mylang-before is the frozen checked source before these five changes.
provenance.historical_environment_note: Older full-application receipts did not pin Go override variables. This run pins GOMAXPROCS=1, GOGC=100, GOMEMLIMIT=off; cross-run comparisons are observational.

relative_timeout_policy.applies_to: checked-ownership uninstrumented warmup and wall invocations; RSS uses the absolute ceiling
relative_timeout_policy.interpretation: A censor exceeded the calibrated wall-time budget; it is not an exact runtime or measured median ratio.
